title: Amazon CloudFront to Amazon S3 and Amazon API Gateway
description: CloudFront to S3 and API Gateway backed by TypeScript Lambda functions

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys a CloudFront distribution and routes HTTP traffic to two backend services based on the URL. Any URLs that have a path beginning with /api/ are routed to an API Gateway which integrates with Lambda Functions which are written in TypeScript. All other traffic is routed to an S3 bucket.
The pattern also includes examples of using Lambda@Edge integrated with CloudFront to implement redirects, and to add CORS headers to API requests.

testing.headline: Testing
text: You can test the solution by accessing the CloudFront distribution domain using a web browser.
